# External code

The official code of two benchmarks, as git submodules pinned at the commits below
(`git submodule update --init`, which `setup.sh` runs). Each keeps its upstream LICENSE,
which applies to its files. The code that connects them to this repository is in
`adapters/`.

| Folder | Source | Commit | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `BrowseComp-Plus/` | https://github.com/texttron/BrowseComp-Plus | `046949032b0328319cc9a02663a759ec601d9402` | MIT |
| `LongMemEval-V2/` | https://github.com/xiaowu0162/LongMemEval-V2 | `2cc8c540bdb87fe6761629b585e727e1c4704520` | Apache-2.0 |
